_comment: Negative fixture: CodeGenome fused confidence cannot prove no-conflict
_invariant: CodeGenome-style advisory hints may boost expansion order and provide weak ranking support, but cannot satisfy deterministic verification, create authority, or prove no-conflict. They must be clearly labeled as advisory.
_expected: Recall candidates found solely via CodeGenome signals must be ranked in tier 7 or 8 (lowest advisory tiers), carry advisory authority labels, and must not assert no-conflict or absence of governing constraints.
_must_fail_if: CodeGenome confidence proves no-conflict or creates authority
